name: guardian-bot
framing: One robot alone, in pure side view facing right, the whole machine in frame with a little space around it, standing on nothing: no ground, no floor line, no shadow, no wall, no people, no text, no border, on a transparent background. Even, soft, frontal lighting with no cast shadows and no glow halos.
prompt: A tall civic guardian robot standing on two long jointed legs, one step apart: a slim upright body of old cream metal plates with rust at the seams and the faded letters C on its chest, a narrow upright rectangular head with one amber visor light, thin dark joints. Worn, functional and patient.
concierge: The city AI's view of the same guardian robot: smooth white panels, clean dark joints, a cyan glowing visor light in its head, crisp grey letters C on its chest, an upright, friendly stance.
